title: 上线后，创始人别当中转站
mission: Preview the EP04 Launch-stage visual language before full voice, TTS, scene graph, and package production.
audience: Founders and AI-native builders moving from MVP to Launch.

timing.audioStrategy: visual sample only; no locked TTS

visualSystem.visualJob: Launch-stage founder bottleneck and system replacement
symbolGrammar: Identify the section key message before designing any symbol.
Comply with the locked Founder Playbook VI before borrowing outside icon references.
Use abstract concept symbols: router node, queue pressure, launch gate, system router, and attention audit lanes.
Motion should explain routing pressure, gate transition, and sorting into repeatable systems.

scenes.claim: After launch, every loop cannot still pass through the founder.
scenes.narration: 产品上线后，如果每个问题都还要创始人接住，公司就没有真正进入增长。
scenes.subtitle: 每个问题都等创始人，公司就还没进入增长。

artifact.symbolMeaning: Multiple request paths converge into one overloaded founder node.

scenes.focusCue: request paths converge on founder node
scenes.motion: requests draw inward, then the founder node pulses as overloaded

scenes.claim: MVP proves the product. Launch proves the business can grow.
scenes.narration: MVP 是证明产品值得存在；Launch 是证明业务能不能重复增长。
scenes.subtitle: MVP 证明产品；Launch 证明增长能不能重复。

artifact.keyMessage: Launch is a repeatability gate, not another feature sprint.
artifact.symbolMeaning: The path crosses from product-exists into a repeatable-growth gate.

scenes.focusCue: MVP gate hands off to Launch gate
scenes.motion: MVP node locks, then Launch gate opens toward repeatable growth

scenes.narration: 真正要审计的是：哪些事可以自动化，哪些可以交给别人，哪些才需要创始人判断。
scenes.subtitle: 重复发生的问题，要变成系统。

artifact.highlight: 自动化 / 交给别人 / 创始人判断
artifact.keyMessage: Founder attention should be reserved for founder-only decisions.
artifact.symbolMeaning: Recurring work is sorted into automation, delegation, and founder-judgment lanes.

scenes.focusPhrase: 自动化 / 交给别人 / 创始人判断
scenes.motion: tasks leave the founder queue and sort into three lanes
